title: atalantia surasiana
intro: Atalantia surasiana, commonly known as the Ceylon citron, is a species of plant in the family Rutaceae, native to Sri Lanka. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Atalantia surasiana include its ability to reduce fever, relieve respiratory congestion, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
